OPERATIVE REPORT

Procedure: Aortic valve replacement with bioprosthesis via full sternotomy.

The patient was taken to the operating room for elective surgical aortic valve replacement
given progressive severe native aortic stenosis. After institution of cardiopulmonary
bypass, the calcified native valve was excised. Given favorable annular dimensions, a
25 mm CE Magna valve was selected and implanted in standard fashion.

Implant Size: 25

Hemodynamic assessment after weaning from bypass showed the mean gradient is 10 mmHg with
trivial paravalvular regurgitation. The chest was closed over mediastinal drains.
